node.title: Re^3: searching two pattern sequentially from one file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [mrityunjaynath],

When I run your code against this sample input, I get the output "the original quartus 9.1" and "the latest quartus 11.1" - so it would seem that the problem is happening elsewhere in your code.

To narrow down where the problem is occurring, sometimes the simplest thing to do is [doc://print] debug output at strategic places in your code to monitor its progress, see also the [id://745674]. Another option is stepping through your code with the [doc://perldebug|debugger] ([doc://perldebtut|tutorial]).

Once you've narrowed down where your problem is occurring, boil down your code and sample input into a [http://www.sscce.org/|Short, Self Contained, Correct Example], that is, a piece of code that compiles and reproduces the problem, along with its sample input and the expected output vs. actual output including error messages (see also [id://174051]), and post it here.

Often this process will help you discover the bug and the fix too! :-)

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
